CommunityApplications.Profile:
Unraid templates for [ph-intercept](https://github.com/m00grin/ph-intercept), a real-time DNS dashboard for Pi-hole, AdGuard Home, and Technitium DNS where blocked queries get shot down by an interceptor ship.
For help, bug reports, and feature requests, open an issue on the [ph-intercept GitHub repository](https://github.com/m00grin/ph-intercept/issues).
